10060 Physics (Polytechnical Foundation)

2026/2027

Spring and Autumn
The course is given in four different schedules dependent on study programme.
Scheme A: F1A and E1A. Scheme B: F5B and E5B. Scheme C: F1B and E1B.
Scheme D: F3A and E3A.
Schema D is taught in English and is for General Engineering but can be followed by others if there is room.
In the course there are experiments which are placed outside the course modules.
F7, E7
Written examination and experiments
The final grade is an overall assessment of a written test (20%), a written exam (60%), and lab reports (20%). There is a two-hour written test in the exam period in the Summer and a written four-hour exam is in the exam period in the Winter. The final exam can cover all subjects. Reexam is offered only for the final written 4-hour exam. FROM COURSE START in 2027, there will no longer be a written test halfway in the course. From then on, the final grade is an overall assessment of a written exam (80%) and lab reports (20%).
Written exam: 4 hours
